name: Madinet Masr for Housing and Development S.A.E.
source: Madinet Masr FY2025 results investor presentation (issuer, appendix financial statements, EGP thousand, stored absolute)
source_note: Read from the issuer FY2025 results investor presentation appendix income statement (EGP thousand, stored absolute) and cross-checked line for line against the issuer FY2025 earnings release of 12 March 2026: Revenue 11,709.9 mn, Gross Profit 7,021.6 mn and Net Profit 3,648.1 mn appear in both. The printed chain ties: Revenue 11,709,886.8 less Cost of Revenue 4,688,256.6 equals Gross Profit 7,021,630.3; Profit Before Tax 4,735,416.6 less Income Tax 1,032,530.5 and Deferred Tax 54,812.4 equals Net Profit 3,648,073.7. Operating Expenses is a derived sum of the three printed cost lines (Selling and Marketing 1,897,670.5 + General and Administrative 576,428.1 + Managing residential compounds and other operating 144,323.6); Operating Profit is the printed Operating Profit, which the presentation states after net finance income. Net Finance Costs is stored as net finance cost (Finance Cost less Finance Income), negative in FY2025 because the company earned more finance income than it paid. Income Tax combines the printed current and deferred tax lines, which is what reconciles to Net Profit. No EPS row: the presentation prints none.
